mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through monetary easing, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% occurs in 30% of cases but S&P 500 20d returns are negative in > 55% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 7.0% signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7.0 occurs in 60% of cases but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 45% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in 50% of cases but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 40% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline during recessions is associated with positive 20d returns in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% triggers aggressive monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% occurs in 30% of cases but S&P 500 5d returns are negative in > 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: PAYEMS decline occurs in 40% of cases but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 45% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weak demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), HOUST decline is associated with positive 60d returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicate severe supply-demand imbalance, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline in 30% of cases but S&P 500 20d returns are positive in > 40% of those instances.
